title: Microsoft unveils new AI laptop powered by Nvidia chips
description: Microsoft (MSFT) and Nvidia (NVDA) revealed their new AI laptop — the Surface Laptop Ultra — capable of running AI agents directly on the device rather than relying on the cloud. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley comes on Market Domination to talk more about the new piece of hardware.

description: Microsoft (MSFT) CEO Satya Nadella and Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang explain how early Azure supercomputing infrastructure accidentally paved the way for OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) to train its breakthrough GPT models.

title: Nvidia CEO: 'If not for Windows, Nvidia wouldn't have been founded'
description: Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang discusses how Microsoft (MSFT) Windows was foundational to Nvidia's creation in the early 1990s. He outlines how key technological milestones — from Windows 95 to DirectX and programmable shaders — enabled the evolution of the GPU and paved the way for CUDA.

title: Microsoft Gets an Nvidia-Powered AI Laptop. Is It Time to Buy?
description: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft and Nvidia scheduled the Surface Laptop Ultra unveiling for October 7, weeks after Nvidia raised its DGX Spark AI desktop price ~75% to $6,950 as memory costs climbed. Microsoft guided FY27 Windows OEM and Devices revenue down in the high teens.

title: Microsoft or Amazon: If I Could Only Own One for the Next 5 Years, It Would Be This One
description: Azure and AWS both posted record-breaking quarters, but one company's cash machine quietly outpaces the other by tens of billions of dollars each year. The gap between them reveals which stock earns a five-year hold and which one demands patience you may not get rewarded for.

title: Bad News for Microsoft: “Basically Zero” AI Use for Most Employees on Copilot

title: Nvidia Takes Aim at Intel’s $32 Billion PC Business With Microsoft’s Surface Laptop Ultra
description: Microsoft (MSFT:NASDAQ) and Nvidia (NVDA:NASDAQ) are set to unveil the Surface Laptop Ultra in San Francisco on Wednesday, October 7, with Satya Nadella and Jensen Huang taking the stage together. The laptop runs on Nvidia’s RTX Spark chips, announced in June, and it’s built to run AI agents on the PC itself instead of in the cloud.

description: Nearly every analyst covering a $3 trillion company agrees it belongs higher, yet the stock still trades below its 52-week high. The real question is how much higher, and the answer depends on a few risks that bulls are quietly glossing over.

title: Beazley Security Strengthens AI Security Capabilities with Microsoft Solutions Partner Designation
description: As organizations accelerate the adoption of AI, Microsoft Copilot, and autonomous agents, security, governance, and data protection have become critical business priorities. As part of a broader AI security strategy designed to help clients navigate this shift, Beazley Security announced it has achieved the Microsoft Solutions Partner for Security designation within the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program.

title: Microsoft and Nvidia to Unveil AI-Powered Surface Laptop Ultra
description: Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) is set to unveil a new laptop powered by Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) chips on Wednesday as the companies expand efforts to run artificial intelligence workloads directly on personal computers. Microsoft Chief Executive Satya Nadella and Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang are expected to introduce the Surface Laptop Ultra at a Microsoft-hosted event in San Francisco focused on Windows and the company’s Surface hardware.

title: RegASK Expands Enterprise Regulatory AI Ecosystem Through Microsoft Marketplace
description: NEW YORK & SINGAPORE, October 07, 2026--RegASK today announced the availability of its AI-native regulatory platform in the Microsoft Marketplace, the unified online destination for customers to buy trusted cloud solutions, AI apps, and agents to meet their business needs. RegASK customers can now discover and deploy trusted solutions through Microsoft Marketplace, with smooth integration and streamlined management across Microsoft Azure and other Microsoft products.
